description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing LLM cost records, including CRUD operations with tenant enforcement and Swagger API documentation.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing LLM cost records and retrieving a specific record by ID.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new LLM cost record.

methods.name: router.put
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing LLM cost record by ID.

methods.name: router.delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an LLM cost record by ID.
